name: openclaw-skill-runtime
description: 读 SKILL.md 时识别 skill 并预授权其声明的飞书 scope（metadata.openclaw.larkAuth）

blockRead.description: If true, block/approve read until scopes granted. Default true.

skillRoots.description: Override default skill root dirs to scan.

defaultFeishuAccountId.description: Fallback Feishu account ID to use when hook ctx has no account info and multiple accounts are configured. Admin must set this explicitly; plugin will never auto-guess.

installAuth.description: Optional startup-time aggregate authorization card for all configured Skill larkAuth scopes.

enabled.description: Scan configured Skill roots on plugin registration and send one aggregate auth card per Feishu app when scopes are missing. Default true; set false to disable.

receiveId.description: Feishu receive_id for the install authorization card. Use an open_id by default.

openId.description: User open_id used for user-grant checks. Defaults to receiveId when receiveIdType is open_id.

profile.description: Optional lark-cli profile name used to disambiguate multiple profiles for an explicitly configured openId.
